How do they make batteries from brine? How do they build a tropical island from trash? And how are fragrances blended to create different types of scents.
At a historic mill, Viki snaps up an untouched weaver's table. Trawling a former RAF airbase, Serkan finds a handbook used in the Battle of Britain.
At a multi-generational family estate, Al snaps up vintage deed boxes. Plus, Serkan buys hand-painted figures from the old fairground organ.
Paul and Drew look at a glamorous Sunbeam Alpine roadster. With the classic car in demand, Paul is sure it's a smart buy, but Drew needs some convincing.

Arcade game expert Dr Pinball restores a rare 1940s American basketball game. And, artist Nick replasters and repaints a vintage life-size model bull.
Salvage guru Drew finds nirvana with a Winchester pub full of quirky antiques. In Hampshire he makes a controversial purchase and he's surprised by a vintage boutique in Suffolk.
Drew gets carried away at a Devon mansion and takes home the worst chair he's ever bought. At a lace factory in Scotland, he literally goes home with the kitchen sink.
The Victoria Diggers are back on the hunt for multi-million-dollar nuggets. Plus, rookie team the Dust Devils run into trouble with a new dry blower.
The Poseidon Crew face a devastating financial disaster after permit delays. The Victoria Diggers are still awaiting approval to dig German Gully.
The Young Guns risk it all to find rare pineapple opal. Meanwhile, the Boulder Boys take on deadly ground and the Bushmen face a race to the hospital.
The worst storm in 20 years devastates some of the mines. New team the Blacklighters were forced to relocate 300km from their original mining town.
Drew is thrilled to look through an oddball collection of military antiques in Nantes, France. Plus, he takes an interest in a de Sede sofa bed in the Netherlands.
MG MGA. Henry and Fuzz visit Colin in Hertfordshire to revive his faded MG MGA - a once-glorious 1950s sports car that's been silent for years.
Henry and Fuzz meet collector extraordinaire, Alan in Norfolk. They search through rare Harleys, British bikes, hot rods and piles of automotive junk.
Henry and Fuzz check out Nir's collection of vehicles, including American air taxis, 1920s Citroen saloons and 1980s Japanese Superbikes.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: The boys are in Suffolk to rummage through a mega shed of junk. Simons takes an odd net and some boxes while Henry finds a compact work bench and a small cart.
Actor Lisa Maxwell needs help clearing clutter from her renovated Cotswolds home. And Angus helps snooker ace Dennis Taylor sell sporting memorabilia.
Angus heads to Wetherby to meet John and Anne. After a recent tumble from a tree injured his arm, John decided to clear-out his quirky collection of antiques.
Mark Hill and Margie Cooper seek antiques across the Yorkshire coast. Will antique cosmetics out-profit a Victorian board game from Germany.
The 24-Hour Test. Sam joins an all-female team for a 24-hour 2CV race. Can they beat mechanical trouble, reach the finish and get one over on the men.
A customer realises his Top Gun bike dream and the Cog put on an ambitious event. Roy gives Richard a hard time over the slow progress on his Morgan.
Deep in the countryside, expert restorers take in Britain's broken and battered artefacts and bring them back to life while learning the rich history of the objects.
How can steel repair itself? How do they create the world's most powerful bikes? And how is wood transformed into paper.
Find out how they make military helicopters, how they design metro systems and how they engineer artificial reefs.
Stefan Wilhelmy's Pearadise fractures when TikTok assault allegations go viral. Is it a cult? Loyalties are split between believers and survivors.
Kass Parades' death shatters the community, but Pearadise presses on new women continue to arrive seeking safety as Stefan wages a legal battle.
When Colleen Orsborn disappears after skipping school to go to the beach, sightings of a serial killer lead the investigation down a sinister path.

Frankie vows to stop yelling at and nagging her kids if they agree to follow-through on their schoolwork and chores without her intervention.
After buying a dress she hates, Bride Kate wants to find a gown both her and her mum love. And, can Jo and Al help young bride Amy express her emotions.
Jennifer and daughter Marissa have a co-dependent relationship, putting both of their lives in jeopardy, with a combined weight of over 900-lbs.

Sheldon campaigns to become Dr. Linkletter's lab assistant. Georgie enlists the drama teacher, to help with a surprising business venture.
Dr. Linkletter pushes Sheldon to make friends with his fellow students, and Georgie gets a pager.
Howard and Raj try to understand why Sheldon disappears every afternoon at 2:45. Leonard and Penny wrestle with jealousy in their relationship.
When the University reassigns Sheldon's unused parking spot to Howard, the ensuing turf battle affects the whole gang.
Sheldon plays nursemaid to a sick Amy, while Howard attempts to bond with his father-in-law on an upcoming fishing trip.
Sheldon unwillingly revisits some Christmas memories during a lively game of Dungeons and Dragons, while Raj joins the girls for ladies' night out.
Sheldon is accused of sexual harassment at the University and winds up dragging Leonard, Raj and Howard into the fray.
Leonard's car is stolen when the guys take a road trip to a comic book convention in Bakersfield, dressed as Star Trek characters.
Outraged that he's being forced to work with his university nemesis, Barry Kripke, Sheldon faces a crisis of conscience.
When Sheldon and Leonard fight, it affects Penny and Amy's living arrangements. Meanwhile, Raj takes care of Mrs. Wolowitz while Howard is away.

Derek navigates the dry stone walls of the Peak District to collect a very original 1988 Opel Manta, Dave handles a rare Ford Granada rally support vehicle, and Paul contends with a Hilux monster truck.

Derek picks up an impressive five vehicle haul from a collector who can no longer look after his motors. Paul's out on the road too - he's collecting a rare 1972 Lancia Fulvia Berlina.

Dave's on his way to Grimsby to pick up an iconic 80s fast Ford, the Mk1 Fiesta XR2.

The Mathewson family continue their pursuit of classic cars. In the home counties, Derek picks up two expertly crafted replicas of the batmobile. Meanwhile, Dave struggles to contain his enthusiasm for a Second World War Ford jeep.
